payout_quote: If you have an automated investing account open at the time your referred friend makes a Qualifying Deposit, Betterment will provide a $150 investing bonus into an eligible automated investing account.
steps: Be a Betterment client with a funded account; get your referral link/code from the rewards center
Invite a personal friend to join Betterment via the Betterment interface
Friend opens a new Betterment account via your link and makes a Qualifying Deposit within 30 days of signup: $10+ into Cash Reserve or $100+ into an individual automated investing account

If you hold an automated investing account when they qualify, a $150 investing bonus is deposited into it on/around the reward date; if you hold a Cash Reserve account, you also get a 0.75% APY boost for 92 days
catches: Cap: Sender Rewards for no more than 5 referrals per calendar year ($750 in investing bonuses/year)
Sender Investing Bonus requires an open automated investing account; $150 deposited to account in priority order (Roth IRA > traditional IRA > SEP IRA > highest-balance taxable)

Qualifying Deposit: $10+ new funds into Cash Reserve or $100+ into individual automated investing account within 30 days of referee signup; 401(k), self-directed, joint/trust, HSA, and checking deposits do not qualify
Sender APY Boost: +0.75% for 92 days on up to $1M in Cash Reserve; boosts stack consecutively up to a 6-month max aggregate duration
You are required to include the referral compensation disclosure when making referrals; invites only to people you know personally
Bonus treated as interest earned for tax reporting — consult a tax advisor; no fee to participate
biggest_catch: Capped at 5 referrals per calendar year ($750 in bonuses) — and the bonus lands inside your investment account, not as spendable cash.
eligibility: Betterment clients with funded accounts; U.S. residents only; referees must be new Betterment clients
timing: $150 investing bonus deposited on/around the friend's Qualifying Deposit; APY boost for 92 days from qualifying deposit

notes: Betterment Refer a Friend: $150 investing bonus per qualifying referral (referrer must hold automated investing account), capped at 5 referrals per calendar year. Plus a 0.75% APY boost on Cash Reserve for 92 days (consecutive boosts capped at 6 months aggregate). Friend must make a $10+ (Cash Reserve) or $100+ (investing) initial deposit within 30 days.
payout_value_note: $150 investing bonus per referral (deposited into investing account, not cash); APY boost valued separately but excluded from payout figures.
numeric_basis: payout from official Betterment 2026 sender terms ($150 investing bonus); time: sharing referral link est. 5-15 min active
when_cash_arrives: '$150 investing bonus deposited on/around the friend's Qualifying Deposit' — per official terms. The bonus posts with the friend's qualifying deposit (no waiting window), but it lands as invested funds inside your Betterment automated investing account, not spendable cash — liquidating + ACH to your bank adds ~3-5 days, still within about a week. Cap 5/year ($750).
maximize: The bonus posts on/around the friend's qualifying deposit — have the friend fund immediately after opening to trigger it.
To make it spendable cash, sell and ACH out right after it posts (adds ~3-5 days) — or leave it invested.
Cap is 5 referrals/year — each is $150, the largest fast-posting brokerage referral here.
